literal: Even if the world is desired, it will come to hand, if one acts having considered the right time and with the right place.
translation: Even the entire world can be successfully acquired if one acts at the right time and chooses the right place.
modern: தகுந்த காலத்தை ஆராய்ந்து, ஏற்ற இடத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், உலகத்தையே அடைய விரும்பினாலும் அது கைகூடும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme power of choosing the right time and place for any action. Even an ambition as massive as conquering the entire world (ஞாலம்) is achievable (கைகூடும்) if one acts. The two essential conditions for this success are carefully choosing the opportune moment (காலம் கருதி) and operating from the most advantageous location (இடத்தால்). Success is presented not as a matter of mere strength, but as a result of perfect alignment with time and space.
